instagram.caption:
The good set you never put on a bed.
The Linen Shelf Zone in the Hall Closet. Holds the sheets, towels, and blankets the beds in this house actually rotate through.

What done looks like:
1. Three sheet sets per bed
2. Each nested inside one of its own pillowcases
3. With the bed size written on the shelf edge underneath. Everyday towels folded to one width in a stack no taller than your forearm. Two spare blankets on the top shelf with nothing balanced on them

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success linen shelf zone.
